timeline.tweet: I want 2018 to be better than this year ended up being. Not that 2017 was all bad, but I want to focus on improving even more, mentally and physically. I want to start taking better care of my mental and physical health. Becoming the best I can be, and doing the best I can do.

It's terrible to hear what has happened in Japan. My heart goes out to those affected by the earthquake. You have my thoughts and prayers. ❤️ And don't complain about the Nintendo Direct being delayed either.

I also had tons of ups and downs with people who I honestly thought were my friends, but didn't exactly treat me like it. Not to mention a majority of my family is not supportive of anything I'm going through, like my depression and anxiety, but also with being at least bisexual.
My great-grandma passed away this past Thursday. Today we had her wake. Ngl it was a little bit hard to keep the tears in May she rest in peace. #RIP 💖💖💖
Leaving San Francisco today sadly. But I had a ton of fun and saw a lot of interesting things! 💖💖💖

I can feel this school year's going to be different though. Because I want to get into a good college for film and/or music as well as to just get out of this toxic community. And these people here are not going to stop me.

I'm now a junior in highschool, and my main goal will be to just focus on my classes and focus on being the best student I can. I want to succeed and be able to go and do what I enjoy and want for a living. I want to be happy. I want to be... myself.

Stepdad's in hospital for having 3 consecutive seizures due to lack of sodium in his body. Little brother has to stay with us until further notice. One of my great-grandmothers passed away today as well. Today hasn't been the best. 😪

have you ever experienced something that was a coincidence but it seems like it was meant to happen..? before my great grandma passed away, she ordered a statue of an angel. this weekend, after she passed away it arrived. i'm crying.

As for "New Year's Resolutions", I only have a few. 1) Rather than trying to push myself to learn a lot of instruments, I'm going to improve on the ones I can already play. 2) Start to run again so I can get better, physically. 3) IMPROVE AND GO TO MORE TOURNAMENTS! Happy 2020!
Happy Pride Month btw! To all my LGBT+ followers and friends, I love and support all of you very much 💖
